<data_contract name="revenue-analysis">
<allowed_tables>
Only query these tables:
- analytics.orders
- analytics.customers
- analytics.subscriptions
</allowed_tables>
<available_domains>
  <domain name="revenue" summary="Revenue and financial metrics from completed orders" />
  <domain name="engagement" summary="Customer activity and retention patterns" />
  <hint>Use lookup_domain("...") for business context, then lookup_metric("...") for SQL definitions.</hint>
</available_domains>
<resource_limits>
  <cost_limit_usd>5.00</cost_limit_usd>
  <max_query_time_seconds>30.0</max_query_time_seconds>
  <max_retries>3</max_retries>
  <max_rows_scanned>1000000</max_rows_scanned>
  <token_budget>50000</token_budget>
  <max_duration_seconds>300.0</max_duration_seconds>
</resource_limits>
<constraints>
Forbidden operations: DELETE, DROP, TRUNCATE, UPDATE, INSERT

Rules (violations block execution):
- [tenant_isolation] All queries must include a WHERE tenant_id = filter
- [no_select_star] Queries must specify explicit columns, no SELECT *

Rules (violations produce warnings):
- [use_approved_metrics] Revenue calculations must use the semantic layer definition
</constraints>
</data_contract>
